There is a tiny pop prior to Raven, not from the CD trackmarking.

I received these discs from the taper after the tour ended. The source was not listed on etree.org, 
but an upgrade to what is was out there. So I extracted with high error recovery, and all tracks
extracted at 100%.

The original CDs had an abrupt fade out directly after Too Much and fade back in right before the Maker.
The encore break was not taped. I have patched in the encore break from the ak40 source with permission
from that taper for an easier and more complete listening experience.

The show has been retracked from its original tracking that included disc introduction tracks.
